title: Explorer notice
responsibility: Shows a side note that qualifies what a screen shows, such as a reading that may be incomplete.

inputs.name: Notice.as
inputs.description: Selects the native element rendered by hx-element; accepted values are p, div and ul, with p as the default.

inputs.name: Notice.className
inputs.description: Sets the class string forwarded to the rendered element; it defaults to ex-notice. This component's color, font size and wrapping styles apply when the class includes ex-notice.

inputs.name: Notice.role
inputs.description: Sets the rendered element's role attribute to note, status, alert or list; it defaults to note.

inputs.name: Notice.id
inputs.description: Sets the rendered element's native id attribute when supplied; it defaults to JavaScript undefined and is omitted otherwise.

inputs.name: Notice.label
inputs.description: Sets aria-label on the rendered element when supplied; it defaults to JavaScript undefined and is omitted otherwise.

inputs.name: Notice.component
inputs.description: Passes the owner attribution to data-harness-component; its default is JavaScript undefined.

inputs.name: Notice.children
inputs.description: Required Svelte snippet rendered inside the selected element; errors raised while rendering it propagate to the owner.

outputs.name: Notice
outputs.description: Renders markup as an hx-element whose native element is selected by as. It forwards className, role, id, label as aria-label and component as data-harness-component, then renders children; the component CSS targets the ex-notice class.

errors.name: Content rendering error
errors.description: An error raised while rendering the required children snippet propagates from the render call to the owner; this component does not catch or replace it.
